title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
abstract: arXiv:2611.24845v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. translated_abstract: 现有的AI智能体能够检索信息、调用工具、运行实验并生成多步骤输出。然而，大多数智能体是围绕相对静态的工作流构建的，难以在环境变化时保持可靠的状态。金融交易使这一局限性尤为突出：价格、新闻、市场状况、投资组合持仓以及可用资金都在持续演变。一个结果只有在与正确的时间、数据快照和执行上下文保持绑定时才是有用的。我们提出了Vibe-Trading，这是一个全面的智能体原生交易框架和一体化工作空间，用于构建、评估和演化金融交易智能体。它统一了市场研究、金融数据、策略生成、回测、投资组合分析、模拟交易、多智能体协作以及可选的券商执行。其核心贡献是一种架构，该架构使结果、证据、研究历史和交易权限保持关联（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出Vibe-Trading智能体原生交易框架，其核心贡献是一种能将结果、证据、研究历史和交易权限与正确的时间、数据快照及执行上下文可靠绑定的架构，从而统一了从市场研究、回测到模拟交易和券商执行的全流程交易工作空间。
en_tdlr: Vibe-Trading is a comprehensive agent-native trading framework whose central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority reliably connected to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context, unifying the entire trading workflow from market research to broker execution.
